Loupe's tabs. A row of tabs that switches between views of one page, or a pill group that switches a view or a setting.

```jsx
<Tabs><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#" aria-current="page">Open</a><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#">Completed</a><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#">All</a></Tabs>
<Tabs variant="segmented"><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#" aria-current="page">Open</a><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#">Completed</a><a className="lp-tabs__tab" href="#">All</a></Tabs>
```

Variants: `segmented`. States: hover, selected.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-tabs` classes of the app.
